interruption_recovery.if_start_exists_end_missing: checkpoint current work, persist close intent, send/verify exactly one END, persist CLOSED
interruption_recovery.if_mission_continues_after_close: automation or foreground may open a NEW tranche with a NEW Gmail START; an automation START is permitted only when the same automation immediately executes at least one real bounded next action and then closes/checkpoints safely
interruption_recovery.in_tranche_deliverables: PDF/report/artifact messages are neither START nor END unless explicitly typed as such
interruption_recovery.no_false_end: Do not treat an intermediate requested deliverable as tranche completion.
interruption_recovery.idempotency: Search/verify provider message IDs before replaying START or END.

close_intent_must_complete.rule: Once forced_stop_new_mutations_local is reached OR CLOSE_INTENT is durable, the foreground worker must stop product mutations and attempt Gmail END immediately; no normal reply first.
close_intent_must_complete.recovery: verify provider thread before replay, then exactly-one END + ACK + CLOSED

foreground_handoff.rule: A tool/user/automation interruption after CLOSE_INTENT does not cancel the END obligation. Reconcile and close old tranche first. If continuation is authorized and no human/security gate exists, open a fresh START and actually continue work.

automation_failover.name: KINLINK Continuity & Comms
automation_failover.trigger: missed END / CLOSE_INTENT orphan / stale WORKING >=28m
automation_failover.repaired_end_subject_rule: KINLINK — FIN DE TRANCHE — date/heure Kinshasa; never expose WATCHDOG/RECOVERY/RATTRAPAGE/FAILSAFE unless technically necessary
automation_failover.human_gate_rule: if true human/security/platform gate, close normally and do not auto-restart
automation_failover.blind_window: Because condition-watch cadence cannot exceed hourly, an active tranche can cross its 25-minute deadline after a healthy watchdog run and remain unobserved until the next hourly run.

foreground_deadline.tool_error_rule: If Gmail send errors without provider message_id, read/search provider state before retry; never assume send failed or succeeded.
foreground_deadline.rationale: Repeated missed END events show 3-minute reserve was too narrow for connector/readback retries. Keep 25-minute total but reserve 5 minutes.
